messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: ran canary of stream-pack adapter (classifier v3) on prod-canary, saw KV miss rate spike and decode-rate jitter.
sam: numbers? p95/p99?
maya: p50 steady, but p95 token-latency up ~2.8x for short prompts. Example from perf-bench:
```
prompt_len=12 -> decode_ms p95 34 -> 98
kv_miss_rate from 3% -> 18%
decode_rate_bucket=fast->slow flip
```
lucas: sounds like kernel selection is picking the 'long-seq' kernel for short prompts after the new batch-formation heuristic. Seen that when length-buckets overlap.
tara: did classifier change bucket thresholds? We recently compressed length buckets to 8/32/128.
maya: classifier v3 uses length buckets [0-16,17-64,65+] and a decode-rate probe that migrates streams if decode tokens/s < 40 -> it migrates to low-latency kernel; bug makes it migrate opposite on transient spikes.
perf-bot: New trace uploaded: https://perf/reports/2356789012-streampack
sam: suggested quick mitigation: restrict bucket recluster to steady-state (apply 5s hysteresis) and cap KV-prefetch on migration.
maya: agreed. Proposed config:
```
streampack:
  bucket_hysteresis_s: 5
  token_budget_caps:
    short: 64
    mid: 256
    long: 1024
  kv_prefetch: capped
```
lucas: also add kernel-selection guard: if avg_kv_miss > 10% don't flip kernel until 10s stable.
tara: i'll run a 10m canary with these flags on prod-canary after MR.
maya: MR ready -> #3456, will add unit test for bucket hysteresis and a simple perf-run integration test.
devbot: canary deploy queued: deploy/streampack-canary -> node-group-3 (id: ng-7)
sam: run load with mixed workload: short-chat(70%), embed(10%), long-doc(20%), use decode-rate skew to simulate tail.
tara: running load now, will post results in 10m :hourglass:
maya: thx. if green we'll roll to 10% and monitor KV miss & p95.
(reacted with :thumbsup: by lucas)
